{'language': 'en', 'text': 'Ted Lasso season 4 still has plenty of new episodes left to air, but thanks to an exciting update from Sigmund Judge, you may not have to wait too long for season 5 once the season finale drops.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'According to reports, Apple will begin production on Ted Lasso season 5 in January of next year.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'When Ted Lasso season 3 wrapped up in 2023, it genuinely felt like the end of the series. Despite the fact that many viewers (and actors) wanted the show to continue, its future was left uncertain.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'Now that Ted Lasso is finally back, all signs point to Apple and Jason Sudeikis having multiple new seasons already planned.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'A thread of posts made by Sigmund Judge on X today brought welcome news on that front.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'Judge has accurately reported breaking news on Ted Lasso and other Apple TV-related series before.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': "With production set to begin in just a few months, there's a strong chance we'll see Ted Lasso season 5 return on Apple TV in 2027.\n"}

{'language': 'en', 'text': "Season 4 will continue to air new episodes through October 7, so there's still plenty of Lasso to enjoy during that time. Even though Apple hasn't officially announced a renewal yet, news of a season 5 renewal will likely come around the tail end of season 4's run.\n"}

{'language': 'en', 'text': "Speaking of which, Ted Lasso co-creator Bill Lawrence's other Apple show, Bad Monkey, is also returning later this year. Meanwhile, his hit series Shrinking is expected to return for season 4 in early 2027.\n"}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'Are you excited that Ted Lasso season 5 is already in the works so soon? Let us know in the comments.\n'}

{'language': 'en', 'text': 'Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and is also available as part of the Apple One bundle.\n'}
